ToolSearch query: "select:mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_get_page"

Then call `mcp__mcp-atlassian__confluence_get_page` for EACH of these page IDs, one at a time:
- 312508418  (TSD: Catalogue Sync — Product, Price & Inventory (MuleSoft → SFCC))
- 356974594  (Sandbox Provisioning — GitHub Actions Workflow Guide)
- 344883203  (04.3.1 BM User Roles & Permissions Matrix)
- 339836947  (Salesforce Business Manager Guides)
- 339935324  (12. CDN, eCDN & Security Configuration)

For each page, find EVERY occurrence of the strings "SCAPI", "OCAPI", "Open Commerce API", "Shopper API", "Shopper Products", "commerce-sdk", "Commerce API". For each occurrence, report back the EXACT verbatim sentence or table row containing it, with enough surrounding words to make the context clear.

Your final message must be a plain list, grouped by page ID + page title, of the exact quoted lines. If a page contains NONE of those strings, say so explicitly for that page — do not guess or infer. Also report the "version" number shown in each page's metadata.

Do not write any files. Do not modify anything in Confluence. Read only.

Audit complete. All five pages read via the Atlassian MCP; read-only, nothing written or modified.

### Cross-page observations worth flagging

- **The two OCAPI-heavy pages contradict the TSD.** 312508418 states twice, unambiguously, that "OCAPI is deprecated and must not be used for new integrations", while 356974594 (version 1, newest page of the set) still describes OCAPI settings as the live sandbox-provisioning mechanism (`config/ocapi-settings.json`), and 344883203 lists both "OCAPI Settings" and "Commerce API Settings" side by side as BM modules without noting which is authoritative.
- **No page in this set mentions `commerce-sdk`, "Shopper API", "Shopper Products", or the expanded form "Open Commerce API"** — every reference is the SCAPI/OCAPI acronym or "Commerce API" as a BM module name.
- Note on "Commerce API" matching: on 312508418 and 339836947 the only hits are the `commerce-api` path segment inside `developer.salesforce.com` URLs, not prose. The single genuine prose/table use of the phrase is on 344883203 ("Commerce API Settings").
